Dunn & Acosta LLP
Conroe, TX
Phone 713-555-4341
Settlement Demand
2 Aug 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1125 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
We represent Sarah Walters in connection with the motor vehicle collision that
occurred on 30 Apr 2024 at a controlled intersection. Our client was proceeding
through the intersection on a green signal when your insured drove into the side of our
client's veihcle after failing to yield the right of way. The force of the impact spun
our client's car partially around and caused the driver's head and torso to be thrown
against the restraint system.
Our client was taken from the scene and evaluated for pain. Diagnostic follow-up has
confirmed a cervical strain and a lumbar strain. Our client has undergone a course of
physical therapy and has been advised to limit lifting and prolonged sitting. Ongoing
stiffness and headaches have interfered with work duties and routine household
activities.
Liability in this matter is clear. The police report and the independent witness
statement both place fault with your insured for entering the intersection against the
signal. We see no reasonable basis for disputing responsibility.
Accordingly, we demand payment of $100,000.00 to resolve all claims arising from this
collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If
we do not receive a staisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without
further notice.
Expert review: Matthew Moore, biomechanical engineer
Sincerely,
Laura Bryant
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
